comment: jscpd configuration for the phase-2 maintainability audit. Lives under .github/ (the scanning harness) so the application tree stays byte-identical to the pinned commit. Copy-paste detection over the application source only; the vendored third-party libraries and node_modules are excluded. min-tokens is left at the tool's own default of 50 so the reported volume is what a user gets out of the box; a sensitivity note on lower thresholds lives in the tool doc. See PLAN-003 and phase-2-tool-selection.md 4.5(a).
